title: The Testaments
author: Margaret Atwood
summary: Set fifteen years after The Handmaid's Tale, this novel is told through three women connected to Gilead, including the feared Aunt Lydia. Their stories move toward a risky attempt to bring the regime down.
readIf: you read The Handmaid's Tale and want to see Gilead from new viewpoints.
skipIf: you have not read the first book, since this sequel assumes you know Gilead already.

pairings.reason: The original novel, which sets up the regime and the world this sequel returns to.
A shorter, younger story about a controlled society and one person who sees through it.
